text:
sara: Running 3 customer validation sessions next week for the observability MVP. Need final demo + a 3-item poll. Focus areas: dashboards, trace hooks (jump links), cost breakdown.
liam: I can do the demo. For cost, customers want per-model and per-route splits. We'll show a mock card with caveats about sampling accuracy.
noah: Ops ask: immutable error fingerprints for audit export. Make the export include sha256 and timestamp.
emily: For sampling controls, ship a read-only indicator in MVP. Full toggle is stretch and needs infra changes.
sara: Proposed acceptance gates: 1) dashboards show real customer data (no placeholders), 2) trace->session link navigates correctly during demo, 3) per-model cost within +/-15% for demo workload, 4) fingerprint export available as CSV/JSON, 5) enabling hooks does not increase p95 by >1.5%.
ops-bot: Reminder: sessions booked with medco (Mon 11:00), ledgerly (Tue 16:00), scaleapps (Thu 09:00).
liam: I'll include a simple canary rollback snippet for the one-pager: ```if error_rate_rollup(5m) > baseline*2 or p95_delta > 0.015:
    revert_release()```
sara: Action items: Liam draft demo + snippet, Noah produce fingerprint export sample, Emily confirm sampling indicator UX, Ops-file infra ticket if we need quota bumps. I'll post the customer poll after noon.
